<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Zakira.Replay</id>
    <version>0.15.1</version>
    <authors>Moaid Hathot</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/MoaidHathot/Zakira.Replay</projectUrl>
    <description>Let LLMs and AI agents "watch" video. Zakira.Replay turns any video source — YouTube URLs, conference recordings, course lectures, local files — into speaker-attributed transcripts (captions or local Whisper STT), frame-level OCR and structured vision (local or LLM-routed), slide-aware grouping, and timestamped JSON evidence that agents can reason over. Ships as both a CLI (`zakira-replay`) and an MCP server (`zakira-replay mcp serve`) in one .NET 10 binary.</description>
    <releaseNotes>0.15.1 — security patch. Updates two transitively-referenced packages that carried known advisories: MessagePack 2.5.198 → 2.5.302 (two high-severity advisories GHSA-hv8m-jj95-wg3x and GHSA-vh6j-jc39-fggf, plus eight moderate; reached via GitHub.Copilot.SDK → StreamJsonRpc) and the SQLitePCLRaw native bundle 2.1.11 → 2.1.12 via Microsoft.Data.Sqlite 10.0.7 → 10.0.11 (GHSA-2m69-gcr7-jv3q, high). No API, CLI, MCP or schema changes. See CHANGELOG.md.</releaseNotes>
    <copyright>Copyright (c) 2026 Moaid Hathot</copyright>
